question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

17, 18, 20, ?, 27, 32
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive whole number series is added subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afa21625d4c73619429d294bc8819fb1485f5ae65b28586bcbea6fd298c44454.png] 

Hence, **"23"** is the correct answer.
